title: SPARK RS classic—SRAM Rival disc
notes: Official China exact-model page supports an HS-EPS+ carbon Spark RS frame, HS-HPT fork, integrated hidden-cable cockpit, XS-XL geometry and an SRAM Rival hydraulic 2x11 factory trim with PW-5 DB alloy wheels. An official purchase link is present but no defensible current rendered price or stock state was available. The public-post custom build is not treated as this factory trim.
